player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Countdown numbers game!
Goal: Combine numbers using +, -, *, / to reach the target.
Action format: [i j op] where i,j are indices and op is the operation.
Example: [0 2 *] multiplies number at index 0 with number at index 2.
Division must result in whole numbers only.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Ifyalembwa fyabula ukufikapo. Fifwile ukuba ifyapusana kabili mu cifulo ca 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Ukubomba kwabipa (ukupenda pa zero nangu ukupanga ifishili fya integer)

outcome.turn_limit: Mipango ya kubadila imeshika. Bafikila kuwaba: {best_value} (inshita: {target})
